props.text:
The major capitalization has already taken place.

It's kind of funny seeing the Fear & Greed Index sitting at 74 (Greed) when $BTC is still roughly 65% below the 126K high lol.

Get ready for the market to remain in Greed for a long time.

Markets can stay irrational far longer than most people expect.
Aligns with group bullish macro sentiment. Reinforces re-accumulation/disbelief phase narrative from KillaXBT's longer-term cycle analysis.
